Simple Process

How It Works

From first browse to confirmed hunt — three steps

1
🔍
Browse Farms

Explore hunting farms across all 9 South African provinces. Filter by region, terrain and species to find the right fit for your hunt.

2
📋
Request a Booking

Found a farm that suits your hunt? Submit a booking request with your preferred dates, group size and species. No payment required at this stage.

3
✅
We Confirm with the Farm

WildHunt SA contacts the farm on your behalf, confirms availability and pricing, and gets back to you within 24 hours with everything you need.

Our Commitment

Why Hunters Choose WildHunt SA

We built WildHunt SA to make it easier for South African hunters to find quality farms, request bookings with confidence, and know exactly what to expect.

🛡️
Curated Farm Listings

Every farm on WildHunt SA is reviewed before going live. We verify contact details, species availability and farm facilities.

⏱️
24-Hour Confirmation

Submit a booking request and WildHunt SA confirms availability with the farm within 24 hours — no chasing, no uncertainty.

🆓
No Upfront Payment

Requesting availability costs nothing. No deposit, no booking fee, no subscription. You only commit once everything is confirmed.

🇿🇦
Built for South Africa

Designed specifically for South African hunting culture, legislation and terrain. Every farm, every species, every province — right here at home.

How the Booking Process Works
1
Submit Your Request

Fill in your preferred dates, group size and hunt type. No payment required.

2
We Confirm with the Farm

WildHunt SA contacts the farm to confirm availability and pricing. We respond within 24 hours.

3
You Finalise Directly

Once confirmed, we introduce you to the farm. All final arrangements are made directly between you and the farm owner.

4
Hunt. No Surprises.

WildHunt SA charges no fees to hunters. Free to submit a booking request. No obligations until you confirm with the farm.

Legal

Privacy Policy

WildHunt SA respects your privacy. We collect only the information necessary to connect hunters with farms and process booking requests.

Information We Collect

Name, email, phone number, and booking request details you submit through our platform.

How We Use It

To confirm booking availability with farm owners, respond to enquiries, and improve our platform. We do not sell your personal information.

Contact

For any privacy queries, contact us at [email protected]

Legal

Terms of Service

By using WildHunt SA, you agree to these terms. WildHunt SA is a hunting marketplace platform operating in South Africa.

1. Platform Nature

WildHunt SA is a discovery and booking-request platform. We are not a hunting operator or tour operator. All hunting arrangements are made directly between hunters and farm owners.

2. Booking Requests

Submitting a booking request creates no obligation. WildHunt SA confirms availability with the farm within 24 hours. No payment is taken through the platform.

3. Farm Listings

Farm owners are responsible for the accuracy of their listings. WildHunt SA facilitates the connection between hunters and farm owners.

4. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of South Africa. Questions: [email protected]
